lines: +# Agent proxy: what was wrong
+- Sessions were keyed only by the episode in the URL, ignoring the agent's `X-Session-ID` / body `session_id`, so
+  explorers were folded into the main agent's single sample. Sessions are now per agent; `finish` on an episode
+  returns every agent's rows under their own ids.
+- Prompts were built incrementally (append the "new" messages to a token buffer), which assumes histories only
+  append and templates render messages independently. Summarization, the agent template's reasoning/user-turn
+  truncation and any history rewrite therefore produced prompts SGLang would never feed, and buffers that only
+  grew caused the spurious max-context errors. Each request is now rendered in full the way SGLang 0.5.9's chat
+  endpoint does (message/tool normalization, tool-call arguments as dicts, content parts, `tool_choice`,
+  `continue_final_message`, per-request `chat_template_kwargs`, generation-config sampling defaults).
+- Engine aborts were mapped to `stop` and outputs were recorded whether or not the agent received them, so aborted
+  and abandoned generations were trained. An abort is now a 502 (agents retry verbatim), a client that leaves
+  mid-generation triggers `/abort_request` and trains nothing, and an identical retry of the last successful
+  request (a response lost downstream) is resent from cache — generated and trained once.
+- Training rows are built from the exact prompt/output ids of each delivered generation. Where a new rendered
+  prompt's text starts with an earlier prompt/generation of the same agent, those exact ids are spliced in
+  instead of re-tokenizing, and the generation extends that row; otherwise it starts a new row. Qwen-style linear
+  conversations stay one row; GLM conversations (reasoning dropped/truncated by harness and template) split.
+- `tools/check_samples.py` could not see any of this: it only re-checks log-probs within a sample, and the old
+  samples were self-consistent with the old proxy's own (wrong) prompts.
+- Replay verification (fake engine, `--abort-rate 0.05`): GLM — 1498 engine prompts all exactly SGLang's
+  rendering, 0 max-context errors, 1414 samples over 76 agents, trained tokens (542241) exactly the non-aborted
+  engine outputs; Qwen — 437 engine prompts all text-exact (84 reuse sampled-token prefixes), 111 samples,
+  trained tokens (290429) exactly the non-aborted outputs. Both pass `check_samples.py` with 0 mismatches, and
+  `tests/test_proxy.py` covers the behaviours above.
